note: ready; synthetic prices and in-memory user state; not a durability or deck-quality evaluation

tools.name: ping
tools.title: Ping
tools.description:
Echo a liveness check.
USE: verifying the server is reachable. NOT: card-data readiness (data_status).
FLOW: (connect) -> ping -> data_status.
ARGS: message (optional; echoed back, default 'pong').
RETURNS: message.

tools.name: data_status
tools.title: Card-data status
tools.description:
Report card-index readiness, bulk-data staleness, and any in-flight ingest.
USE: checking data exists before searching; polling during data_ingest. NOT: deck state (deck_status).
FLOW: ping -> data_status -> card_search.
ARGS: none.
RETURNS: has_index; bulk_age_hours + stale (age of the served bulk data vs the refresh interval); ingest {running, phase download|build|done|error, snapshot, cards, error}. A server that booted WITH an index hot-swaps onto a finished ingest automatically; after a first-ever ingest (has_index false) restart/reconnect to get the card tools.

tools.name: data_ingest
tools.title: Card-data ingest
tools.description:
Download Scryfall bulk data (~700MB) and rebuild the local card index atomically.
USE: first-run setup; refreshing a stale snapshot. NOT: quick checks (data_status).
FLOW: data_status -> data_ingest -> data_status (poll).
ARGS: force:true rebuilds even when upstream is unchanged.
RETURNS: started, already_running — returns immediately; poll data_status for phase. One run at a time; a failed run never corrupts the served index.

tools.name: card_search
tools.title: Card search
tools.description:
Search cards with Scryfall query grammar against the local index.
USE: finding candidates by type/color/cost/text/set, e.g. "t:instant ci<=wu mv<=2 o:draw" or "set:hob t:legendary". NOT: one known card (card_get); resolving a name (card_resolve_name).
FLOW: deck_status/analyze_role_coverage -> card_search -> deck_add.
ARGS: query (Scryfall grammar incl. set:/e:, rarity:/r:, year, is:commander, is:gamechanger); order name|mv|price|released; limit (max 175); cursor (from next_cursor); owned_only:true restricts to the collection (no-op until collection_set).
RETURNS: results[] lean CardRefs (oracle_id, name, mv, ci, type), total, returned, next_cursor.

tools.name: card_get
tools.title: Card get
tools.description:
Fetch full Card objects by name or oracle_id, singular or array.
USE: reading oracle text/roles/legality/prices for known cards. NOT: browsing (card_search).
FLOW: card_search/deck_get -> card_get -> deck_add.
ARGS: cards: "Sol Ring" | [names or ids] (oracle_ids is a legacy alias); include_printings:true for the heavy printings[] (default lean: default_usd + cheapest_usd instead); compact:true trims to gameplay essentials (oracle text, cost, types, ci, commander legality, roles, usd) — use for batches over ~15 names; 50+ fit compactly.
RETURNS: cards[] (full or compact Card + pricing), missing[] (unresolvable inputs).

tools.name: card_resolve_name
tools.title: Resolve card name
tools.description:
Resolve one card name to its canonical oracle_id.
USE: explicit disambiguation when a name may be ambiguous. NOT: routine adds — deck_add and card_get accept names directly.
FLOW: (name in hand) -> card_resolve_name -> deck_add.
ARGS: name; exact:true disables the fuzzy fallback.
RETURNS: oracle_id + lean card. Errors: AMBIGUOUS_NAME carries candidates[]; UNKNOWN_CARD carries did-you-mean suggestions[].

tools.name: card_printings
tools.title: Card printings
tools.description:
List every printing of a card (set, collector number, prices), newest first.
USE: picking a printing or price-shopping one card. NOT: batch pricing (card_get's default_usd/cheapest_usd).
FLOW: card_get -> card_printings -> (choose printing).
ARGS: card (name or oracle_id; oracle_id is a legacy alias).
RETURNS: oracle_id, printings[].

tools.name: collection_set
tools.title: Set collection
tools.description:
Replace the owned-card collection.
USE: loading what the user owns before ownership-aware search or budgeting. NOT: adding a few cards (collection_add).
FLOW: (owned list) -> collection_set -> card_search (owned_only) / budget_plan (use_collection).
ARGS: cards: name-or-id, single string or array.
RETURNS: owned_count, total, owned[]/cards[] (echo capped at 200), unresolved[]. Session-scoped; resets on restart.

tools.name: collection_add
tools.title: Add to collection
tools.description:
Add cards to the owned-card collection.
USE: growing the owned set incrementally. NOT: replacing it wholesale (collection_set).
FLOW: collection_get -> collection_add -> card_search (owned_only).
ARGS: cards: name-or-id, single string or array.
RETURNS: owned_count, total, owned[]/cards[] (echo capped at 200), unresolved[].

tools.name: collection_get
tools.title: Get collection
tools.description:
Read the owned-card collection, paginated.
USE: reviewing what's loaded. NOT: ownership-filtered search (card_search owned_only).
FLOW: collection_set -> collection_get -> (page with cursor).
ARGS: limit (default 200); cursor (from next_cursor).
RETURNS: owned[]/cards[] page, total (exact), next_cursor.

tools.name: collection_clear
tools.title: Clear collection
tools.description:
Empty the owned-card collection for this session.
USE: starting ownership tracking over. NOT: swapping in a new list (collection_set replaces in one call).
FLOW: collection_get -> collection_clear -> collection_set.
ARGS: none.
RETURNS: owned_count 0.

tools.name: deck_create
tools.title: Create deck
tools.description:
Create a versioned deck and return its deck_id.
USE: starting a new build. NOT: loading an existing list (deck_import).
FLOW: (idea) -> deck_create -> deck_set_commander.
ARGS: name; commanders (name-or-id, single string or array; applied immediately — color identity is computed at create; legality is still checked by deck_set_commander/validate_deck); command_zone_kind single|partner|background|doctor_companion (inferred when omitted); format.
RETURNS: deck_id, deck, vitals (card_count/100 incl. command zone, land_count, color_identity, legal, version).

tools.name: deck_get
tools.title: Get deck
tools.description:
Fetch a deck's full contents.
USE: reading the card list. NOT: a health overview (deck_status); finding decks (deck_list).
FLOW: deck_list -> deck_get -> deck_add/deck_remove.
ARGS: deck_id; expand:true for the full Card per entry (default lean oracle_id+qty+name).
RETURNS: deck (cards[], commanders, computed_color_identity, version).

tools.name: deck_list
tools.title: List decks
tools.description:
List decks as lean entries.
USE: finding a deck_id or surveying builds. NOT: full contents (deck_get).
FLOW: (session start) -> deck_list -> deck_get.
ARGS: limit (default 50).
RETURNS: decks[] {deck_id, name, version, commanders (names), card_count}, total.

tools.name: deck_rename
tools.title: Rename deck
tools.description:
Rename a deck.
USE: retitling. NOT: content changes (deck_add/deck_remove).
FLOW: deck_list -> deck_rename -> deck_status.
ARGS: deck_id; name; expected_version for optimistic concurrency (mismatch returns conflict, no mutation).
RETURNS: ok, name, version, vitals.

tools.name: deck_delete
tools.title: Delete deck
tools.description:
Delete a deck permanently.
USE: discarding a build. NOT: undoable experiments (deck_snapshot then deck_restore).
FLOW: deck_list -> deck_delete -> deck_list.
ARGS: deck_id.
RETURNS: deleted:true.

tools.name: deck_snapshot
tools.title: Snapshot deck
tools.description:
Capture an immutable snapshot of a deck's current state.
USE: checkpointing before risky edits. NOT: copying to a new deck (deck_export then deck_import).
FLOW: deck_status -> deck_snapshot -> (edit) -> deck_diff.
ARGS: deck_id.
RETURNS: snapshot_id, version.

tools.name: deck_diff
tools.title: Diff deck
tools.description:
Compare a snapshot against the current deck (or a second snapshot).
USE: reviewing what changed since a checkpoint. NOT: legality (validate_deck).
FLOW: deck_snapshot -> (edits) -> deck_diff -> deck_restore.
ARGS: deck_id; snapshot_id (baseline); to_snapshot_id (optional target, default current).
RETURNS: diff {cards {added, removed, changed}, metadata changes}.

tools.name: deck_restore
tools.title: Restore deck
tools.description:
Roll a deck back to a snapshot.
USE: undoing edits since a checkpoint. NOT: deleting the deck (deck_delete).
FLOW: deck_diff -> deck_restore -> deck_status.
ARGS: deck_id; snapshot_id.
RETURNS: deck, vitals. Keeps deck_id; version bumps (restore is itself a mutation).

tools.name: deck_import
tools.title: Import decklist
tools.description:
Parse decklist text (Moxfield/Archidekt/MTGO/Arena/plaintext) into a deck.
USE: bulk-loading an existing list. NOT: adding a few cards (deck_add).
FLOW: (list text) -> deck_import -> deck_status.
ARGS: text; deck_id (add to existing) or name (create new).
RETURNS: deck_id, resolved_count, unresolved[] (per line, with candidates/suggestions — never silently dropped), vitals.

tools.name: deck_export
tools.title: Export decklist
tools.description:
Export a deck as plaintext '<qty> <name>' decklist lines.
USE: sharing or moving a list out. NOT: reading structured contents (deck_get).
FLOW: validate_deck -> deck_export -> (share).
ARGS: deck_id; format text.
RETURNS: text (quantity + card identity only; per-entry set/collector data is not stored).

tools.name: deck_add
tools.title: Add cards
tools.description:
Add cards to a deck; accepts names or oracle_ids, singular or array.
USE: putting specific cards into a deck. NOT: bulk decklist text (deck_import); browsing candidates (card_search).
FLOW: card_search/meta_recommend -> deck_add -> deck_status.
ARGS: deck_id; cards: "Sol Ring" | ["Sol Ring", {card:"Island", qty:8}]; force:true applies rule-breaking cards flagged illegal; expected_version for optimistic concurrency.
RETURNS: verdicts[] (ok | rejected+violations | added_illegal), failed[] (unresolved inputs with suggestions/candidates — one typo never aborts the batch), vitals — no follow-up deck_get needed.

tools.name: deck_remove
tools.title: Remove cards
tools.description:
Remove cards from a deck; accepts names or oracle_ids, singular or array (qty defaults to 1).
USE: cutting cards. NOT: rolling back many edits (deck_restore).
FLOW: deck_status/analyze_curve -> deck_remove -> deck_status.
ARGS: deck_id; cards: "Island" | [{card, qty}]; expected_version for optimistic concurrency.
RETURNS: version, failed[] (unresolved inputs), vitals. Decrements quantity; entries drop at zero; over-removal clears (idempotent).

tools.name: deck_set_commander
tools.title: Set commander(s)
tools.description:
Set or replace the deck's commander(s) by name or oracle_id, single string or array.
USE: choosing the command zone; changing color identity. NOT: the other 99 (deck_add); a what-if check (validate_commander).
FLOW: card_search (is:commander) -> deck_set_commander -> meta_recommend.
ARGS: deck_id; commanders; command_zone_kind single|partner|background|doctor_companion (inferred when omitted); expected_version.
RETURNS: ok, computed_color_identity, version, vitals — or ok:false + violations (nothing applied; current-state vitals).

tools.name: deck_set_companion
tools.title: Set companion
tools.description:
Declare or clear the deck's companion by name or oracle_id.
USE: setting a companion (empty/omitted clears it). NOT: commanders (deck_set_commander).
FLOW: deck_set_commander -> deck_set_companion -> validate_deck.
ARGS: deck_id; companion; expected_version.
RETURNS: ok, companion, condition_met (advisory — validate_deck runs the full deckbuilding-condition check), violations, vitals.

tools.name: validate_deck
tools.title: Validate deck
tools.description:
Run the authoritative Commander legality gate over a deck.
USE: the final is-this-legal verdict (core + commander + companion rules). NOT: a quick standing check (deck_status); one candidate card (validate_card).
FLOW: deck_add/deck_import -> validate_deck -> deck_export.
ARGS: deck_id.
RETURNS: ok (true only with zero errors), violations/errors/warnings (echoes capped at 50), error_count, warning_count (exact), exemptions (legal qty>1 cards).

tools.name: validate_card
tools.title: Validate card (precheck)
tools.description:
Pre-check whether adding one card would be legal — read-only, no mutation.
USE: testing a candidate before committing. NOT: applying it (deck_add already pre-checks per card); whole-deck legality (validate_deck).
FLOW: card_search -> validate_card -> deck_add.
ARGS: deck_id; card (name or oracle_id; oracle_id is a legacy alias); qty.
RETURNS: ok, violations[] (card-scoped identity/banlist/singleton).

tools.name: validate_commander
tools.title: Validate commander(s)
tools.description:
Check command-zone legality for a deck or a transient commander set.
USE: what-if pairings before committing. NOT: applying (deck_set_commander validates on write).
FLOW: card_search (is:commander) -> validate_commander -> deck_set_commander.
ARGS: deck_id, OR commanders (name-or-id, single string or array) + command_zone_kind.
RETURNS: ok, violations[], computed_color_identity.

tools.name: analyze_curve
tools.title: Analyze mana curve
tools.description:
Compute the deck's quantity-weighted mana-value histogram.
USE: curve-shape questions, incl. filtered views by role/color. NOT: the one-call overview (deck_status includes the curve).
FLOW: deck_status -> analyze_curve -> deck_remove.
ARGS: deck_id; exclude_lands; role (functional role); color W|U|B|R|G.
RETURNS: buckets {0..6, 7+}, total.

tools.name: analyze_composition
tools.title: Analyze composition
tools.description:
Count deck cards by card type and functional role, quantity-weighted.
USE: type/role breakdowns. NOT: gaps vs target bands (analyze_role_coverage).
FLOW: deck_status -> analyze_composition -> card_search.
ARGS: deck_id.
RETURNS: by_type, by_role, total.

tools.name: analyze_stats
tools.title: Analyze stats
tools.description:
Compute exact deck stats: counts, average mana value, color pips, prices.
USE: precise numbers for tuning (LLMs miscount — this doesn't). NOT: the one-call overview (deck_status).
FLOW: deck_status -> analyze_stats -> budget_plan.
ARGS: deck_id.
RETURNS: total_cards, nonland_cards, avg_mv, avg_mv_nonland, color_pips, total_price_usd (default printings), min_buy_usd (cheapest printings).

tools.name: analyze_mana_base
tools.title: Analyze mana base
tools.description:
Analyze mana sources: per-color counts, tapped/untapped, fixing, under-supported colors.
USE: land-base tuning ('any color' sources count toward each identity color). NOT: curve shape (analyze_curve).
FLOW: deck_status -> analyze_mana_base -> card_search (t:land).
ARGS: deck_id; threshold (per-color source floor, default 10).
RETURNS: total_lands, untapped_lands/tapped_lands, sources (per color, lands + rocks + dorks), fixing_sources, under_supported.

tools.name: analyze_role_coverage
tools.title: Analyze role coverage
tools.description:
Compare functional-role counts against target bands (under/ok/over).
USE: finding what the deck lacks (ramp, draw, removal...). NOT: EDHREC suggestions (meta_recommend).
FLOW: deck_status -> analyze_role_coverage -> card_search.
ARGS: deck_id; bands {role: {min, max}} (sensible Commander defaults otherwise).
RETURNS: gaps[] {role, have, want_min, want_max, status}. Advisory — never feeds validate_deck.

tools.name: deck_status
tools.title: Deck status (one-call dashboard)
tools.description:
Report the deck's full standing in one offline call.
USE: after any batch of edits — the default orientation call, replacing a validate_deck + analyze fan-out. NOT: power bracket (meta_classify_bracket, live data); the full card list (deck_get).
FLOW: deck_add/deck_import -> deck_status -> card_search/meta_recommend.
ARGS: deck_id.
RETURNS: vitals (card_count/100, land_count, color_identity, legal, version); legality (errors capped at 20, exact error_count/warning_count); curve (buckets, avg_mv); mana (sources_by_color, under_supported); roles (below-band gaps); price (total_usd, min_buy_usd).

tools.name: simulate_deck
tools.title: Simulate deck (goldfish)
tools.description:
Goldfish the deck: Monte Carlo opening hands and early turns, deterministic per seed.
USE: keepable/mulligan rates and opening-hand SHAPES (mulligan-guide material). NOT: combat, interaction, turn-to-win; land counts (analyze_mana_base).
FLOW: deck_status -> simulate_deck -> analyze_mana_base.
ARGS: deck_id; trials (max 100000); seed (fixed seed = identical results); on_the_play; hand_size; max_turns.
RETURNS: keepable_rate, dead_on_arrival_rate, opening_land_distribution, scenarios (hand-shape rates from type lines + roles: textbook, land_light_mulligan, two_lands_no_accel_mulligan, lean_and_accelerated, explosive, top_heavy_trap, playable_no_accel, flood), lands-by-turn.

tools.name: budget_plan
tools.title: Budget plan
tools.description:
Plan the deck toward a price target with zero card changes.
USE: reprint savings, cost drivers, over-budget gap, acquire cost vs the owned collection. NOT: replacement suggestions (meta_budget_swaps).
FLOW: analyze_stats -> budget_plan -> meta_budget_swaps.
ARGS: deck_id; target_usd; limit (max 100); use_collection:true for acquire_usd (needs collection_set).
RETURNS: min_buy_usd, default_total_usd, reprint_savings_usd, reprint_suggestions[], cost_drivers[], over_min_buy_by_usd, acquire_usd. Local-index price floors, advisory.

tools.name: meta_commander_profile
tools.title: Commander profile (EDHREC)
tools.description:
Fetch a commander's EDHREC average-deck profile.
USE: raw meta context for a commander (top cards + themes). NOT: deck-grounded suggestions (meta_recommend).
FLOW: deck_set_commander -> meta_commander_profile -> meta_recommend.
ARGS: commander (name); limit (default 50).
RETURNS: cards[] {name, inclusion, synergy, category}, total_cards (full profile size), themes[]. Live EDHREC, cached; degrades when upstream is down.

tools.name: meta_recommend
tools.title: Recommend cards (EDHREC)
tools.description:
Suggest cards to add from the commander's EDHREC profile, grounded against the deck.
USE: rank:synergy (default) for 'what fits next'; rank:inclusion (+min_inclusion) for 'what staples am I missing'. NOT: cheaper replacements (meta_budget_swaps); offline gap analysis (deck_status).
FLOW: deck_set_commander/deck_status -> meta_recommend -> deck_add.
ARGS: deck_id; rank synergy|inclusion; min_inclusion; exclude_lands; limit (default 25, max 100).
RETURNS: suggestions[] {oracle_id, name, synergy, inclusion, category} — in identity, not already present, ready for deck_add; unresolved[]. Live EDHREC, cached; degrades when down.

tools.name: meta_budget_swaps
tools.title: Budget swaps (EDHREC)
tools.description:
Suggest cheaper functional replacements for the deck's most expensive cards.
USE: cutting cost via out/in swaps from the commander's EDHREC profile. NOT: additions (meta_recommend); zero-change reprint savings (budget_plan).
FLOW: budget_plan -> meta_budget_swaps -> deck_remove.
ARGS: deck_id; target_usd (stop once under budget); limit (default 10, max 50).
RETURNS: swaps[] {out, in, roles_matched, savings}, current_min_buy_usd, projected_min_buy_usd. Heuristic role match + local price floors — review before swapping.

tools.name: meta_combos
tools.title: Combos (Commander Spellbook)
tools.description:
Find combos reachable from the deck via Commander Spellbook.
USE: what the deck can assemble (pieces, result, steps). NOT: bracket impact (meta_classify_bracket counts combos itself).
FLOW: deck_status -> meta_combos -> deck_add.
ARGS: deck_id; include_almost:true for one-card-away combos; limit (default 20).
RETURNS: combos[] (with source + confidence), included_count, almost_count (exact totals).

tools.name: meta_classify_bracket
tools.title: Classify bracket
tools.description:
Classify the deck into the official Commander brackets (1 Exhibition … 5 cEDH).
USE: power-level conversations and pod matching. NOT: legality (validate_deck); offline stats (deck_status).
FLOW: deck_status -> meta_classify_bracket -> deck_remove.
ARGS: deck_id.
RETURNS: bracket, rationale, pushers (Game Changers, fast mana, tutors, mass land denial, two-card combos, extra turns). Game Changers come from the local index snapshot (live-list fallback for old indexes) + Spellbook (degrades gracefully); cEDH (5) never auto-assigned.
